_readme: Generated by the Growth Ledger (Creators tab), which is now the source of truth for these links. It republishes this folder automatically within a minute of any change; hand edits are overwritten. RULE: ct must equal the slug, and the slug must equal the Growth Ledger link slug, or the ledger cannot match installs to the creator. Creator slugs = lowercase initials (sm); if taken, first two letters of each name joined by a dash (sh-ma).
_pt_help: Apple provider token. App Store Connect > App Analytics > Acquisition > Campaigns > Generate Campaign Link; copy the pt= value. Until it is set, links redirect without campaign tracking.
